mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_order (order_no, user_id, store_id, status, payment_status, total_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, remark, deleted) VALUES (#{order.orderNo}, #{order.userId}, #{order.storeId}, 'PENDING_PAYMENT', 'UNPAID', #{order.totalAmount}, 0.00, #{order.payAmount}, #{order.remark}, 0)

INSERT INTO dc_order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name_snapshot, product_image_snapshot, base_price, unit_price, quantity, subtotal, deleted) VALUES (#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.imageUrl}, #{item.basePrice}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.subtotal}, 0)

INSERT INTO dc_order_item_option (order_item_id, selection_type, option_group_snapshot, selected_name_snapshot, price_delta, deleted) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{selectionType}, #{groupName}, #{selectedName}, #{priceDelta}, 0)

INSERT INTO dc_order_stock_reservation (order_id, order_item_id, reservation_type, product_id, extra_id, quantity, released) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{type}, #{productId}, #{extraId}, #{quantity}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_cart_item SET deleted = 1 WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND deleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dc_cart WHERE id = #{cartId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.store_id, s.name AS store_name, o.status, o.payment_status, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.remark, o.create_time FROM dc_order o JOIN dc_store s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.store_id, s.name AS store_name, o.status, o.payment_status, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.pay_amount, o.remark, o.create_time FROM dc_order o JOIN dc_store s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.id = #{orderId} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT id, product_id, product_name_snapshot AS product_name, product_image_snapshot AS image_url, base_price, unit_price, quantity, subtotal FROM dc_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id

SELECT id, selection_type, option_group_snapshot AS group_name, selected_name_snapshot AS selected_name, price_delta FROM dc_order_item_option WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, status, payment_status FROM dc_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT order_item_id, reservation_type, product_id, extra_id, quantity FROM dc_order_stock_reservation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND released = 0 ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_order_stock_reservation SET released = 1 WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND released = 0
UPDATE dc_order SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_status = 'UNPAID' AND deleted = 0
